title: migrate review-aggregator to contract v2
goal: Migrate plugins/agent/review-aggregator to contract v2: v2 result file with verdict/disposition/reason, ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS-based lens collection replacing the glob, required:true summary on every exit path, valid_verdicts declared, interrupt handling.

steps.description: Write the failing v2 acceptance tests (test-first). New file tests/unit/review-aggregator-v2-test.sh covers every DoD item: manifest declares result_contract:2, valid_verdicts:[complete,degraded], review_report_md required:true; running the plugin writes result_contract/verdict/disposition/reason into review-report.json; ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS lens_result array is read when set; summary is written on a passing run, an empty-input run, and a simulated interrupt; no artifact paths constructed in plugin.sh (grep assertion). All assertions fail against the current tree — the red step.

Update plugins/agent/review-aggregator/manifest.yaml for v2 contract. Add result_contract:2 under provides:. Change valid_verdicts from [] to [complete, degraded] (complete = ran to completion; degraded = interrupted). Change review_report_md output required: false → required: true. Add a comment that the cleanup hook is intentionally absent (mirrors review-lens pattern). No router: section needed — this plugin makes no LLM calls.

Update plugins/agent/review-aggregator/plugin.sh for v2 contract. (a) Source scripts/lib/stage-summary.sh. (b) Add _ra_input helper (reads .inputs[$id] from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS, mirrors _rl_input in review-lens). (c) Add _ra_collect_lenses_inputs: reads .inputs.lens_result from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS — the engine provides a JSON array of member paths for a map group (ADR-055 §1.4) — and normalises them via _ra_normalize_files. (d) Remove _ra_collect_lenses_glob entirely. (e) Update _review_aggregator_run_inner: discovery order is ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS first, roster fallback; after writing review-report.json add v2 fields result_contract:2/verdict:complete/disposition:complete/reason; write review_report_md (summary) via render+atomic_write on every exit path including the early out_json-empty guard; register SIGTERM/SIGINT trap that writes degraded/interrupted result and summary then re-raises. (f) Ensure all exit codes are 0 or 1 (the rc:2 early path becomes rc:1 with summary written).

Update tests/unit/review-aggregator-test.sh to align with v2. Update SPEC-3: remove the assertion that .verdict is absent; add assertion that .verdict == 'complete' (v2 contract requires a verdict field). Update the glob-based fixture setup for SPEC-1/SPEC-6/SPEC-7/SPEC-8 to also set ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS pointing at a JSON index file listing the lens paths (the tests use the same artifact files; ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS is a parallel path to them). Add summary-exists assertions to SPEC-6 (empty group still writes summary) and SPEC-8 (hook path writes summary). Verify SPEC-5 equivalence test still passes unchanged. Update tests/unit/review-aggregator-roster-test.sh minimally if ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS must be cleared in the roster test scope to force the roster path.

notes: Router budgets (ADR-054 §1816): skipped — the aggregator makes no LLM calls; the manifest correctly carries no router: section and the issue does not require adding one. Glob removal: the existing SPEC tests write lens-*.json fixtures and call _review_aggregator_run_inner directly with an artifact_dir; after the glob is removed those tests must either (a) set ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS or (b) call via the roster path. The plan uses approach (a) — set ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS to a JSON file listing the fixture lens paths — because it tests the new primary path and keeps fixture filenames unchanged. The roster fallback is still exercised by review-aggregator-roster-test.sh. SPEC-3 currently asserts 'no .verdict field' which will INVERT under v2; this is a correct test update, not a scope expansion. The valid_verdicts are complete (happy path) and degraded (interrupt); the aggregator has no model-call failure path so router_reason_disposition is not needed here. The summary output (review_report_md) doubles as both the rendered markdown report and the ADR-055 §9 summary; writing it unconditionally via render_review_report_md satisfies both concerns without a separate stage_summary_write call, provided the rendered content names the verdict as required by §9. Interrupt test: the test simulates the interrupt by calling the trap handler directly (pattern from review-lens SPEC-13) rather than sending a real SIGTERM, which is the established unit-test pattern.
